Apply the lifting statement to obtain an etale extension with an isomorphism on the quotient and a lift into it (proof lines 3449-3451).

proof_roadmap: Lifting after an etale extension (proof lines 3449-3451).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that every algebra map from a smooth algebra into the quotient of a henselian pair lifts to the ring itself. The proof base changes the smooth algebra along the ring, obtaining a smooth algebra over the ring to which the lifting statement for smooth morphisms applies, and thus an etale extension of the ring inducing an isomorphism on the quotient together with an algebra map into it. The henselian property of the pair supplies a section of that etale extension, and composing the two maps gives the required lift.
